## What landed

- **`connectors/src/connectors/dot_511.py` (+219)** — the declared
  status disposition + coordinate precision: `assert_target_status_disposition`
  validates `status_disposition` against the closed `_STATUS_DISPOSITIONS`
  set (`"removal"` is the only member) and requires a removal target to
  carry its declared `removal_status_values` vocabulary — a defect
  raises `StatusDispositionNotDeclared` at validate/expand/emit, never
  a per-record rejection and never a bound minted on an unverified
  status. `_entry_from_raw` reads the published status column under the
  disposition: a row whose status is a declared removal value bounds the
  device — a published date column (the new `removal_date_fields`
  alias) emits `valid_to` with `valid_to_kind="exact"`; a removal flag
  with no date emits `valid_to_kind="unknown"` — never a fabricated
  date (P4), never a deletion (I9a NEW-2); every claim the row emits —
  entity, coordinates, status, name — shares the one bound so the
  device is never half-removed, and the paired inventory rows stay
  open. A non-removal status mints no bound and rides `camera_status`
  verbatim (the S5 guard). `assert_target_coordinate_precision`
  validates `coordinate_precision` against the closed
  `_COORD_PRECISIONS` set (`"approximate"` — Milford's published
  "approximate locations, not GPS data" caveat); the mark stamps the
  entity row + the three coordinate claims so an approximate point is
  never re-asserted downstream as exact (§19.1/P4). `CameraRegistryEntry`
  re-validates both fields in `__post_init__` — a hand-built entry
  cannot smuggle an invented label or an exact-less bound.
- **`connectors/src/connectors/cli.py`** — `sig-connectors validate`
  gains the P36.5 status/coordinate registry rule
  (`target_status_violations`).
- **`dot_511_vocab.toml` → 2026.10.12.2** — `removal_date_fields` is
  new (read only when the row's published status is a declared removal
  value); field aliases `LAT`/`LONG`/`NAME` (Temecula all-caps),
  `Location_Name` (Marble Falls), `StateRoad` (FDOT route label),
  `Town`/`Permit_Jurisdiction`/`City` (sub-state jurisdiction detail),
  `DirectionFacing`. Additive only.
- **Sixteen target rows pinned** — `camera_registry_targets.toml`:
  `fdot_d3_flock_inventory` (407 live-read) +
  `fdot_flock_removal_status` (523 live-read,

  Pueblo (114 live-read, Lat/Long attribute pair), Rocky Mount (74),
  Prince William (29, `status` carries Active/Proposed), Leon Overwatch
  layer-2 Vigilant Fixed LPRs (11 live-read → `alpr-fixed`; the
  service's RTCC/CCTV layers are DIFFERENT targets with separate typing
  when registered). Shelbyville/Temecula/Marble Falls/Milford/Elgin/
  South Fulton/Pittsylvania/Alabaster/Thomasville/Peachtree carry the
  ≈50 plan estimate, marked in `notes` — a layer outgrowing its planned
  pages fails loud on `exceededTransferLimit`. Every row: `technology`

  `outFields=*`), `verified`, `jurisdiction_scheme="iso.3166_2"` +
